name: cad-tool
description: Create, validate, version, render, and export parametric CAD models with build123d and the bundled CAD CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Build and verify parametric CAD models.
interface.longDescription: A local-first CAD workflow for Codex using build123d and self-contained .456d model packages, with geometry checks, design history, previews, and STEP/STL export.
defaultPrompt: Create a parametric CAD model from these dimensions.
Validate this .456d model and export STEP.
Modify this CAD design and commit a new version.
